\textit{Note.} Contact windows are pre-registered per estimator (EKF3 [+155, +215] s, UKF [+146, +218] s, FGO [+145, +196] s); EKF3's +242.1 s at half real-time (RTF 0.5) is after its registered window. The simulator ran at half real time; the commanded flight speed was unchanged at 0.5 m/s. n = 1 flight per estimator without heading; closed-loop run-to-run variability is unmeasured; no comparison across real-time factors. Bounds: heading-error bound max $\le$ 2\textdegree{}; lateral-speed bound $\le$ 0.25 m/s (the final FGO node's flight 3, 0.246 m/s, is the closest call: a start-of-climb flow-validity event, a shared limitation of the sensor pipeline). Heading error mean per flight: EKF3 0.22 / 0.21 / 0.22; UKF 0.24 / 0.25 / 0.25; FGO 0.21 / 0.22 / 0.19 \textdegree{}. Every flown FGO flight used the original FGO priors (initial yaw $\sigma$ 1e-3 rad). Earlier builds: Table A.1.\par
\textit{Note.} Ordering verdicts used in the footnotes: RULE MET = a pre-registered rule was applied and met, so its ordering (or similarity) is claimed; case (i) TEST RUN, RULE NOT MET = a pre-registered decision rule with a 'no ordering' outcome was applied and gave that outcome; case (ii) FAILED AS WORDED = a pre-registered prediction of an ordering or a similarity was scored literally and is false, which does not by itself establish the opposite ordering; case (iii) NO COMPARATIVE TEST REGISTERED = values are descriptive. n always names its unit (flights, bags, losses).\par
\textit{Note.} [a] Ordering basis, Experiment 1C closed loop, EKF3, final UKF port and final FGO node. Metric: without heading: wall-contact time after cruise start against each estimator's own contact window, s; with heading: pass/fail of the five closed-loop criteria and the estimator-validity criterion, with max $|$cross-track$|$ in cruise (m), heading error p95 and max (\textdegree{}) and max lateral speed (m/s). n = 1 flight per estimator without heading and 3 flights per estimator with heading (each estimator flew its own flights: separate, unpaired flights). Rule: per-estimator criteria only (H1.8 contact window and H1.9 the five criteria; METHODOLOGY.md:4948, METHODOLOGY.md:7513, METHODOLOGY.md:8995, METHODOLOGY.md:4951, METHODOLOGY.md:4966, METHODOLOGY.md:7362); no comparative test between the estimators was pre-registered, and the comparison across the with-heading sets is 'DESCRIPTIVE; separate flights, n = 3 each, no ordering claim' (METHODOLOGY.md:9355). Result: with heading 3/3 / 3/3 / 3/3 flights pass (EKF3 / UKF / FGO); max cross-track 0.24--0.33 / 0.22--0.25 / 0.03--0.39 m. Verdict: case (iii), NO COMPARATIVE TEST REGISTERED: values are descriptive.\par
